items.source: Arab News

Khan highlighted the importance of this achievement for advancing scientific excellence in Saudi Arabia, particularly in relation to Vision 2030's emphasis on a secure digital economy.

items.source: Arab News

items.source: Arab News

The ministry encourages consumers to report violations through multiple channels.

items.title: KSrelief project to provide safe water to 200,000 Rohingya in Bangladesh
items.source: Arab News
items.source_excerpt: A new program funded by the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center aims to provide safe water and hygiene to over 200,000 Rohingya refugees in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh.
